caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a dark brown, ornate backrest featuring symmetrical, curved and interlaced openwork patterns. The chair has straight legs and horizontal supports connecting the legs near their base. The seat of the chair is cushioned and upholstered in a light-colored fabric decorated with a floral and vine pattern in muted tones of gray and green. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with the chair positioned centrally and filling most of the space. There are no other objects present in the composition.
title: Side Chair
